notes.title: Update 0.4.8.5
notes.content:
[p]Good day, friends. An update was released today.
[/p][p]New[/p][p]- Four new items have been added to Svetlana's clinic and in town for the exchange of medicines. This exchange will become active after completing a certain quest.[/p][p]- When killing mobs and bots, a white crosshair will quickly appear in your crosshair, indicating the enemy's death.[/p][p]- High beams can now be used in vehicles.[/p][p]- Faction Descriptions have been added to the "How to Play" section of the main menu.
[/p][p]Resource Exchange and Turn-in: Allows you to increase your reputation.[/p][p]- The Herbalist, Svetlana, and the Lab Technician in town now accept orders for herbs, 6 items each.[/p][p]- The NPCs listed below now accept goods after completing certain quests:[/p][p]Lab Technician in town - 2 items.[/p][p]Svetlana in town - 11 items.[/p][p]Nikolai in the village - 9 items.[/p][p]Forester in the forest - 11 items.
[/p][p]Map[/p][p]- Minor adjustments to model positions on the level.[/p][p]- The lighting system for round indoor lamps has been changed; there should now be no backlighting near the lamp.
[/p][p]Transport[/p][p]1) New Car Improvements[/p][p]- Doubled power,[/p][p]- Gear ratios in the transmission and 5-speed gearbox have been adjusted,[/p][p]- Top speed = 120+ km/h,[/p][p]- Increased traction.[/p][p]2) Old Mustang - Increased traction, reducing sway at high speeds.[/p][p]3) High beams can now be used in cars. Activate them by pressing the headlight button twice. Pressing the button again will turn the lights off. The light cycle is: Off -> Low -> High -> Off.[/p][p]4) To enhance realism and comfort, when selecting the interior camera (view from inside the car), the engine sound volume is now halved.
[/p][p]User Interface[/p][p]- All new content has been translated. 2,200 new words.[/p][p]- While in a vehicle, you can now hide interface panels: F1 will hide/show the control panel, and F2 will hide/show the instrument panel. These keys are only active while in the vehicle.[/p][p]- A map marker has been added for the Lab Assistant, located in the city's Scientists' Yard.[/p][p]- Some UI name and tooltip fixes (Trunk-Storage), tooltips for crafting types and inventory categories.[/p][p]- Dialog box area sizes have been changed. The player response area has been increased due to the addition of the exchange and delivery mechanics. The overall dialog box width has been expanded by 50 pixels, so all dialogs now display correctly. Convenient return links to the exchange/delivery list have been added to prevent the dialog from closing with each action.
[/p][p]Changes[/p][p]- The number of F-1 grenades sold by the Chief Military Officer has been changed: now 10 instead of 1.[/p][p]- Bandits riding buses near the base will appear less frequently.
[/p][p]Miscellaneous[/p][p]- Pain pills are now also sold by Svetlana at the clinic and Nikolai in the village.[/p][p]- Weapon movement has been added to the rear when firing and the return movement after firing. This increases the recoil effect.[/p][p]- Health healing through the service has been adjusted; health is now fully restored.
[/p][p]Have a great time and enjoy the game.[/p]

notes.title: Update 0.4.8.3
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, Chemists![/h3][p]We continue to improve the game and do everything we can to make your experience engaging, flexible, and enjoyable.
In this update, we've added several important new features and improvements — from the new contracts system to upgraded save slots and UI enhancements.[/p][p]Here’s what’s included in the latest version:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]New Item Exchange and Contracts System[/h3][p]A new system for item handover and NPC exchange has been added. You could call it a contract system.
Players can now give specific items to certain characters and receive rewards in return — experience, money, reputation, or rare items. This works as a full-fledged quest-like mechanic, but without formal quests.[/p][p]To access item exchange or trophy handover, players must first complete a special task from the corresponding NPC.[/p][p][b]First available deliveries:[/b]
The Hunter now issues contracts for the delivery of trophies.[/p][p]More contracts and deliveries will appear in future updates.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Save System[/h3][p]The game now auto-saves using three distinct slot types with unique names:[/p][list][*][p][b]BagSaveGame[/b] — after sleeping.[/p][/*][*][p][b]QuestSaveGame[/b] — after completing a quest.[/p][/*][*][p][b]AutoSaveGame[/b] — upon entering a specific, possibly safe, zone.[/p][/*][/list][p]Each type will receive a shared sequential save number regardless of its type.[/p][p]Slot data will be displayed as:
[b]\[Name] No.\[number], \[date in DD.MM.YYYY format], \[time in HH:[/b]MM:SS][/p][p]This feature is still being tested but will be available in upcoming versions.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Changes[/h3][p]✅ Fixed black screen during fast travel with the Guide NPC
✅ Svetlana now provides healing services for various conditions. Similar services will be available from other medicine-related NPCs
✅ Svetlana received a new dialogue about the item storage chest
✅ A new quest has been added to the Hunter
✅ Changes made to the “Gas Station Recon” and “Supply Run” quests
✅ Skill upgrade UI rework — before upgrading, a popup now shows the skill’s info and cost, with Upgrade/Cancel options. XP info updates immediately
✅ New notifications when drawing a weapon in a safe zone
✅ Mutant marker bug fixed — now appears properly (though with a slight delay)
✅ Fixed collision on the Hunter’s attic beams so players can walk through correctly
✅ Pause menu now includes a separate load button (to the right of the main one, shown as a sheet icon)
✅ Removed safe zone on the bandit base — it was interfering with combat
✅ Localization improved[/p][hr][/hr][p]Thank you to everyone who continues to support the project, leaves feedback, and helps us grow.
[b]You are our motivation![/b][/p]

of the quick access panel.[/p][p]- The quick access panel now displays the rarity of items in frames.[/p][p]- Information about the level of radiation and chemistry was moved to the upper central part Now you can also sleep or take a pill to restore maximum health and remove health wear (fatigue).[/p][p][/p][h2]Quests and Dialogues[/h2][p]- The reward for the quest to meet with Petrenko in the village has been reduced.[/p][p]- Reached the gas station in reconnaissance - save the game.[/p][p]- Changed the initial dialogue with Nick.[/p][p]- Changed some dialogue lines for the hunter.[/p][p]- Changed in receiving kv from the guide.[/p][p]- Fixed errors in tasks and dialogues for the Fisherman (Provisions), the Military (Liquidation and Lawlessness), Cooper.[/p][p][/p][h2]World[/h2][p]- Edits with the level.[/p][p]- Simplification of the effects of toxic smoke.[/p][p]- Changed the appearance of one of the lighting lamps to a simpler one. notes.title: Update 0.4.8.1
notes.content: [p]Update 0481 is already in the game! The world continues to change: dust storms, new routes, interface improvements and zone optimization. We continue to improve every detail - from lighting to quest logic, so that your survival becomes even deeper. Below is the full list of changes:[/p][p][/p][h2]World and environment[/h2][list][*][p]Weather now appears a little more often; sandstorm added.[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting updated: Lumen adjusted, light nights implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]Storm brightness reduced from 14 to 8 units.[/p][/*][*][p]The direction of the sun and moon relative to the north has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Smooth animation of the sun's movement has been implemented - jerks have been eliminated.[/p][/*][*][p]Two new parking lots have been added to the city.[/p][/*][*][p]A new road connecting the forest and the city has been built.[/p][/*][*][p]Industrial zone #2 has been optimized - rendering of objects has been improved depending on the distance.[/p][/*][*][p]In the abandoned building in the forest, interior models have been added to previously empty rooms.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor changes to starting points of interest.[/p][/*][*][p]Added markers for a number of locations and NPCs to the main map.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated tooltips on the main map buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized Clinic #14.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Gameplay and mechanics[/h2][list][*][p]Turning on the headlights of vehicles is now done by pressing the L key.[/p][/*][*][p]Cars received a position reset function - the R key moves the car 1 meter forward and up in the direction of the camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a limit on the transported weight: the starting car holds 100 kg.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of the first-person camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Minimized the shift in gaze when entering and exiting the sight.[/p][/*][*][p]Pistols are now held with one hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Loot boxes and objects available for search now have a ring marker when approaching (on the "normal" difficulty and below).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Combat and balance[/h2][list][*][p]The level of wolves in the passage from the forest to the lagoon has been reduced to level 5.[/p][/*][*][p]The wolf at the sawmill is now level 3.[/p][/*][*][p]The hunter now has black wolves.[/p][/*][*][p]The sorting of cartridges has been streamlined: now they are sorted by increasing rarity when changing the type of cartridges.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Workbenches[/h2][list][*][p]The models of workbenches for crafting and repair have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]The main military man has both workbenches in his apartment and basic equipment has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The collision of all workbenches has been fixed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Items and trade[/h2][list][*][p]A level 1 fishing rod has been added to the sale of the Forester and Hunter. It becomes available upon reaching 100 reputation points with the Hunters faction.[/p][/*][*][p]You can also buy bait (worms) for fishing from them.[/p][/*][*][p]Condensed milk has been removed from the Fisherman's quest line.[/p][/*][*][p]The MAG-10 pistol icon is now displayed without a silencer.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Quests[/h2][list][*][p]About 10 fixes have been made to improve the initial experience of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Descriptions of 22 quests have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]The Forester has a new quest.[/p][/*][*][p]The quest description interface has been redesigned and improved.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]The visual style of the stamina bar has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]All fixed and new content has been translated.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor improvements to the logic and geometry of the map have been added (about 8).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your support, ideas and feedback - it is thanks to you that the world of the game continues to evolve. This update is another step towards creating a living, dangerous and rich world after the disaster.[/p][p]Continue exploring, sharing your findings and reporting problems. We are already working on the next patch. See you soon![/p]

notes.title: Update 0.4.8
notes.content:
[p]Hello Friends, in this major update, fishing has been added. The project recently turned 6 years old, and in honor of this, you will receive double experience.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585123/a87b31702b0d88ce34aff7832c33207ba12f5a5a.png"][/img][/p][h3]Fisherman's Shop[/h3][list][*][p]A diagram of the forest cave has been added to the Fisherman's trade for reputation.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fisherman sells 2 types of bait. The Bartender sells breadcrumbs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fishing rods of different rarities can be purchased with sufficient reputation with the Hunters.[/p][/*][*][p]Notes on each fish, its bait preferences, and fishing spots are available.[/p][/*][*][p]The Fisherman sells a smoking recipe book and a recipe for creating a smokehouse.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fishing[/h3][list][*][p]You can fish at special spots in the form of small bridges by the water.[/p][/*][*][p]Currently, there are 10 such spots on the map.[/p][/*][*][p]Different types of fish are caught at each spot.[/p][/*][*][p]All caught fish are placed in a can on the bridge.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Character Stat Influence[/h3][list][*][p]Strength, dexterity, and constitution help you pull the fish out faster.[/p][/*][*][p]The bite rate is affected by the luck parameter, the time of day, and different bait preferences.[/p][/*][*][p]Dexterity gives the player more reaction time to hook the fish.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Fishing Rod Durability[/h3][list][*][p]The closer the weight of the caught fish is to the rod's maximum weight limit, the faster it breaks.[/p][/*][*][p]The more damaged the rod is, the less weight you can catch.[/p][/*][*][p]The better the rod, the less it breaks from heavy fish.[/p][/*][*][p]The rod can be repaired at a repair bench.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is the kind of fish that inhabits the world of the game.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585123/cd6f3d22017f1fd052237d2f09b9044621e3c0a3.png"][/img][/p][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Fish weighing 1 kg or more can be dismantled for parts. From a fish, you can get: Fish skin parts, bones, fillet, fat, and pieces of meat.[/p][/*][*][p]Fish do not stack, as they have different weights.[/p][/*][*][p]A map marker for the Fisherman has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]You can sleep on the couch at the Fisherman's place.[/p][/*][*][p]The smokehouse is used with a campfire to smoke fish fillets.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quests[/h3][list][*][p]A quest to find the fisherman is available from the Hunter (starts the fisherman's questline).[/p][/*][*][p]The Fisherman has a questline of 8 quests: search, provisions, components, smokehouse, 12 fish, smoked fillet, weapon, and gear.[/p][/*][*][p]The main military officer has a new quest related to the fisherman.[/p][/*][*][p]A hidden quest from Petrenko is available during the fisherman's questline.[/p][/*][*][p]A task has appeared from Evgen at the construction site near the bridge to the village.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Miscellaneous[/h3][list][*][p]Increased the chance of obtaining soft and sheet rubber.[/p][/*][*][p]Glue can be crafted by breaking down bones into crushed bones. Recipes can be bought from three traders.[/p][/*][*][p]The value of items made from old bolts, nuts, screws, and nails has been increased, as the items are now being sold.[/p][/*][*][p]Armaturych has now opened a shop selling various metal parts.[/p][/*][*][p]Knives: Those who sell, for example, the M5 knife, now also sell lower-tier knives, except for M3 and below.[/p][/*][*][p]The player's wet clothes issue has been fixed; they now dry when entering a building.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization of new content - 3000 new words.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]The main menu map has been optimized.[/p][/*][*][p]The texture size of some assets has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]The resolution of marauder head textures has also been reduced.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Increased Experience Gain[/h3][list][*][p]Experience is given for each fish caught.[/p][/*][*][p]In honor of the upcoming 6th anniversary of the project, everyone in the game gets double experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience from cooking on a campfire has been doubled.[/p][/*][*][p]Experience is now also given for regular crafting without equipment.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585123/be8a17c57486d4580ddc777d8a66b0f693988d93.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Map[/h3][list][*][p]In the city, in the northern courtyard, scientists have begun to set up their base.[/p][/*][*][p]A bridge has been added to the herbalist.[/p][/*][*][p]A military trader has appeared in the city who sells weapon sights. These sights are universal and can be mounted on many weapons.[/p][/*][/list][p]The deployment of the scientist camp in the northern part of the city has begun.[/p][h3]User Interface (UI)[/h3][list][*][p]The display of firing modes has been changed: it is now represented by icons in the bottom right corner of the weapon panel.[/p][/*][*][p]The size and position of the current and total ammo indicators on the weapon panel have been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]The ammo type now affects the color of the displayed information about the ammo and firing mode. This allows the player to understand by color whether the loaded ammunition is strong or weak, without looking at their names, simply by using the game's standard color rarity scale.[/p][/*][*][p]Now in trading, right-clicking on an item from a trader or player will display information about the item. This does not apply to all items.[/p][/*][*][p]The design of the weapon modification window has been changed.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Weapons[/h3][list][*][p]Weapon behavior has been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Sound indication has been added for a low amount of ammunition in the magazine (starting from 4 rounds), so the player will know by the sound that they are low on ammo. This works for all types of weapons.[/p][/*][*][p]AS VAL - firing animation has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to use sights for the SVD; a default adapter was added to it to allow for the installation of sights.[/p][/*][*][p]Weapon components have been added to the first filter in the inventory, which contains weapons and ammunition.[/p][/*][/list][p]The update is already available! We hope you find it interesting.[/p][p]We ask you to share your impressions — your feedback is important for the further development of the project. If you have any questions or something seems unclear, join the discussions, and we will try to help.[/p][p]Thanks for playing[/p]

Enjoy the game and have a great mood.

notes.title: Welcome to the city
notes.content:
Hello Friends, the plot, the main driving force in the game, has come to the city, which means we are here for a long time.

What does this mean?

- This means that now most of the time will be spent on improving the appearance of the city location and adding NPCs to their places. The settlement of the city will take place in several stages.

1) The main characters that are needed by the plot.
2) Secondary characters that relate to the plot, with one touch the NPC will already be standing in the city.
3) Secondary characters for additional tasks - those NPCs that do not relate to the plot at all will be added at the last moment, but this does not mean that their quests will be boring and short.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585123/49a970b88febd205a9335c3b90a6551dd4d7fe89.png[/img]

Each NPC has its own story and they have their own quest line, upon completion of which you will be given a valuable item or information.

The place near the NPCs will also be worked out to emphasize their activities in the game world.

And all this takes time to fill and optimize it all, since we are already on the way to building the game Hub - a city with many factions and the largest place for NPCs at this stage of development.

With each update, I will try to add 1 minimum and 3 maximum NPCs to the update, but it is possible and faster, but they may be without tasks and interesting dialogues. So we continue to work.

Thank you for being there and supporting the project with purchases. I will be glad to receive feedback, discuss problems and shortcomings to make it even better. Since I test and others, they give me information about what is wrong, and I expect the same from you. Since not everything that I tested may be all the errors, there may still be problems that you have, but not me. So if something happens, then be sure to write so that I write it down and fix it, if I have it already written down, then this bug is known and will be fixed as development progresses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585123/283e4529b7bebc72fd13efda1850514f96b215f1.png[/img]

So let's keep in touch and move forward.

notes.title: New technologies already in the project
notes.content:
Good day friends.

Not so long ago, the release of Unreal Engine 5.2 took place, in which we transferred the development of the project.
Also, development was also carried out on version 5.1, but as a test of the engine version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585123/73c79c05ce33c6814085f25cd2a05f5f548804f1.jpg[/img]

[h2]What does the new version give?[/h2]
5.0 and later versions are new technologies and features.
One of the main advantages of the 5th version is World Partition - now the creation of an open world has become better and easier.
Lighting Lumen - already used in the project. Beautiful and high quality light.
Lumen is a new system of global illumination and reflections in Unreal Engine 5. It creates fully dynamic indirect lighting, taking into account the parameters of geometry, materials and light in the scene.
Nanite technology - auto-generation of lods, we use it in difficult cases.
You can read more about the new technologies of the new version in other sources.

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
Update of the weather system - sandstorms are now possible, this weather phenomenon will occur in a desert area.
Update and development of existing locations (places of interest) - everything that was transferred from earlier versions will be transformed and redone.
New vegetation - The game is dominated by mixed forest, a mixture of broad-leaved and coniferous trees.

notes.title: Game news
notes.content:
Hello friends, today we will talk about the game and answer a couple of questions that you would ask if you showed even the slightest interest in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585123/a50a1119b89872dab774e010e87fef00ae59d064.jpg[/img]

- Why so long?
- Delays in both news and content are due to the fact that we completely began to remake the game under a different base of the game, since the base of the demo was at its peak and any interference in the code and content threatened us with big bugs and problems. And a collective decision was made to start everything from scratch and completely rewrite the base of the game, so that it would be convenient to fill and have nothing to lose with the slightest changes. And the base was designed for joint development.

Where and how are we going?
- The movement goes into joint development. We rely on SVN collaboration technologies, which allows a team to work simultaneously on different parts of the game without interfering with each other. This allows you to quickly and efficiently do your job. The movement is moving slowly but surely and in the right way.

- What's new in the game?
- If we consider what was in the demo and take a new one, then in the game we will have a system for leveling a character by skills and abilities, everyone calls it differently, but the bottom line is that there are basic parameters that can be pumped, and there are specific ones when pumping which you will definitely you will know where it will go and what will improve.
- Another thing to add is the division of the game world into 14 locations, they are large and use almost all optimization systems, which makes it possible to run on weaker computers. Also, this division was associated with the unification of zones of diverse content, which means that in one location there will always be some kind of empty place, both forests of the road field, and densely populated areas of interest.

- When can we expect the game?
- The game will be released in early access and will be gradually filled, of course, this has its pros and cons, but we think you know about it yourself.

- Will the game be paid?
- Yes, since any of you can support the development by purchasing the game.
